reason: The README describes a DSH Web GUI plugin whose primary purpose is improving user-written prompts through model-based rewriting with a local fallback and confirmation-based replacement.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中将输入草稿改写并补充为更清晰具体的提示词，支持模型增强、本地离线兜底和确认后回填。
summaries.en: Enhances draft prompts in the DSH Web GUI through model-based rewriting, a local fallback, and confirmation before replacing the input.

capabilities: rewrites the user’s current prompt draft using the selected model
sends the draft to a host-provided local HTTP route for model processing
uses a local intent-based fallback when the model or network is unavailable
optionally retrieves prompt-engineering resources from GitHub for source display
adds an input control, confirmation dialog, settings section, and diagnostic records
